title: Kanche
desc: Hari and Eeshwar are two soldiers fighting the Nazi forces during World War II. Hari has to sacrifice his love and life to make a mistrustful Eeshwar understand some facts about living in harmony.

title: Manyam Puli
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: SALAAR PART 1
desc: The future of a fiercely disputed nation hinges on the strained dynamics between Deva and Vardha Raja, two allies-turned-enemies.

title: Pokiri
desc: Krishna, a police officer, disguises himself as a thug and joins the mafia in order to wipe out the underworld. Meanwhile, he falls in love with Shruti, an aerobics teacher.

title: Simhamanti Chinnodu
desc: A young man is assigned to protect the daughter of a powerful landlord whom he admires. Soon, the bodyguard falls in love with an anonymous admirer of his, unaware that she is the landlord's daughter.

title: Hanumanthu
desc: Hanumanthu, a simpleton, goes on a revenge spree after discovering that Krishnamurthy had murdered his father, Hanumanthiah.

title: Addiction Killer
desc: The host presents a wide range of Ayurvedic remedies for addiction that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

title: David Billa
desc: Small-time diamond smuggler David befriends Goa-based gangster Abbasi. However, David soon joins hands with an international criminal, much to Abbasi's infuriation.

title: Darling
desc: Prabha prepares to meet Nandini, his childhood friend, at a reunion party organised by his father. However, things take a turn when Nisha, a gangster's daughter, falls in love with him.

title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
desc: Venky, an unemployed youth, heads to Hyderabad for a marriage ceremony. What seems like a brief vacation gradually turns into something more, when the soon-to-be bride falls for him.

title: K-Ramp
desc: A rich businessman, Krishna, sends his wayward son, Kumar, to Kerala in order to reform him. There, Kumar falls for Mercy, a girl with PTSD and suicidal tendencies.

title: Jetlee
desc: A flight attendant encounters severe peril during a transit from Dubai to Kochi. Consequently, she confronts this urgent crisis.

title: Julayi
desc: When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.
